text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a café-style lunch plate: two slices of flatbread pizza with cheese, red onion, tomato sauce and meat, a mixed green salad, diced grilled chicken, and dark red beans (likely kidney beans).

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A square white dinner plate, about 25 cm per side. Because it is square, I used side² instead of the circle formula: area ≈ 625 cm². The dish of green beans at the left edge is not part of this meal.

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Flatbread pizza (2 pieces)
- Mixed greens with carrot shreds and a few olive or cucumber bits
- Diced chicken breast
- Kidney beans
- A light dressing on the salad (assumed)

**STEP 4 - Area:**
| Item | Share of plate |
|---|---|
| Pizza | ~17% |
| Salad | ~25% |
| Chicken | ~22% |
| Beans | ~4% |
| **Total** | **~68%** |

The rest of the plate is visibly empty, so 68% coverage fits.

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
| Item | Area × height | Gross volume |
|---|---|---|
| Pizza | 106 cm² × 1.2 cm | 128 ml |
| Salad | 156 cm² × 4 cm | 625 ml |
| Chicken | 137 cm² × 1.5 cm | 206 ml |
| Beans | 25 cm² × 1.5 cm | 37 ml |

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Pizza: 128 ml × 0.85 ≈ 109 g
- Salad: 625 ml × 0.15 ≈ 94 g
- Chicken: 206 ml × 0.85 ≈ 175 g
- Beans: 37 ml × 0.7 ≈ 26 g
- Dressing: about 8 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
| Item | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pizza | 109 | 250 | ≈ 273 |
| Salad | 94 | 30 | ≈ 28 |
| Chicken | 175 | 165 | ≈ 289 |
| Beans | 26 | 127 | ≈ 33 |
| Dressing | 8 | 450 | ≈ 36 |
| **Total** | **≈ 412 g** | | **≈ 659 kcal** |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A generous portion of chicken, two small flatbread slices and a salad add up to about 400 g and 650 kcal. That is plausible for this plate.
